commands.command:
set -Eeuo pipefail
echo "=== STEP: baseline boot id ==="
cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
echo "=== STEP: OS info ==="
cat /etc/os-release | head -3
echo "=== STEP: current pwquality config ==="
sudo -n cat /etc/security/pwquality.conf | grep -Ev '^\s*#|^\s*$' || echo "(no active directives)"
echo "=== STEP: current password-auth pam ==="
sudo -n grep pwquality /etc/pam.d/system-auth /etc/pam.d/password-auth
echo "=== STEP: backup config ==="
sudo -n cp -a /etc/security/pwquality.conf /etc/security/pwquality.conf.bak.$(date +%s)
echo "=== STEP: set minlen and minclass ==="
sudo -n sed -i \
  -e 's/^#\?\s*minlen\s*=.*/minlen = 12/' \
  -e 's/^#\?\s*minclass\s*=.*/minclass = 3/' \
  /etc/security/pwquality.conf
grep -q '^minlen' /etc/security/pwquality.conf || echo "minlen = 12" | sudo -n tee -a /etc/security/pwquality.conf >/dev/null
grep -q '^minclass' /etc/security/pwquality.conf || echo "minclass = 3" | sudo -n tee -a /etc/security/pwquality.conf >/dev/null
echo "=== STEP: verify config applied ==="
grep -E '^(minlen|minclass)' /etc/security/pwquality.conf
echo "=== STEP: ensure pwquality enforced for root too (enforce_for_root) not required but check retry) ==="
sudo -n grep -E 'pwquality' /etc/pam.d/system-auth
